_comment: The Welcome screen's pages (Welcome.qml), one per Hearth OS version (MAJOR.MINOR, as the version is shown). A version without its own page shows "default". Each item: an icon from icons/, a title, one line, and the Settings page it opens.

1.14.title: Mantel runs on KWin now
1.14.sub: Desktop Mode has KDE's window manager under Hearth's own look, and Settings has much more of what KDE has.

items.title: KWin under Mantel
items.body: Smoother windows, HDR and variable refresh rate on screens that have them.

items.title: More sound settings
items.body: Balance, a speaker test, apps on other speakers and push to talk.

items.title: Power your way
items.body: Other times on battery, what the lid does, battery health and history.

items.title: Save your look
items.body: A wallpaper per screen, a slideshow, and My looks to keep how it all looks.

items.title: Languages
items.body: Several languages in order, spell check, Chinese, Japanese and Korean typing.

items.title: Info Center
items.body: Your processor, graphics, memory and every USB and PCI device in detail.

items.title: Make it yours
items.body: Looks, wallpaper, the bar and dock.

items.title: Updates
items.body: Hearth keeps the version before, so you can always go back.

items.title: Gaming
items.body: Steam Game Mode, controllers and remote play.
